name: grapix
description: GrapiX broadcast graphics editor, sequencer, and renderer platform.

scripts.certify:e2e: npm run build -w @grapix/shared-types && npm run build -w @grapix/sdk && npm run build -w @grapix/renderer-protocol && npm run build -w @grapix/api-server && cargo build --manifest-path services/render-daemon/Cargo.toml && node tools/certification/run-local-e2e.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build -w @grapix/shared-types && npm run build -w @grapix/sdk && npm run build -w @grapix/renderer-protocol && npm run build -w @grapix/api-server && npm run build -w @grapix/editor-web && npm run build -w @grapix/desktop-electron
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @grapix/shared-types && npm run build -w @grapix/sdk && npm run build -w @grapix/renderer-protocol && npm run typecheck -w @grapix/api-server && npm run typecheck -w @grapix/editor-web && npm run typecheck -w @grapix/desktop-electron && npm run check -w @grapix/desktop-tauri
